conversation.speaker: owen
conversation.text: Jules, the old grudge over a red umbrella is still an open grudge. You never explained the part that made you look guilty.

conversation.speaker: jules
conversation.text: The red umbrella that always brought my guard down was a trap used by some dark souls that just keep throwing me a curve for sure! Now I want it back just in case! What are they for, Jules? Do them what you please!

conversation.speaker: sarah
conversation.text: Jules, I'm jealous, and I hate how much I still want your attention after the fake wedding in Duluth.

conversation.speaker: owen
conversation.text: I heard that someone did cheat, Jules. That was dishonest behavior and not a sign of jealousy or misunderstanding. Let me explain what actually happened.

conversation.speaker: jules
conversation.text: Let me tell Sarah how Jules has clarified for her that cheating isn’t just some minor blunder and the result of lack of trust in their relationship; Jules must know she shouldn’t blame them.

conversation.speaker: sarah
conversation.text: Mara, I still want you here even though I'm pissed. Stop dodging me and talk about the motel fire nobody agrees happened.

conversation.speaker: mara
conversation.text: Enough, Sarah. This is beneath me. If we're going to talk, explain the abandoned radio-tower dare instead of boring me.

conversation.speaker: jules
conversation.text: I've already got the idea of why I love this radio tower so much, and it's been a while since I've used it. But you've already heard the details and the reason. That's where you can come to the real story in your own way.

conversation.speaker: sarah
conversation.text: Mara, that's bullshit. You don't get to dismiss me and then act surprised when I get angry about the disputed tattoo pact.

conversation.speaker: mara
conversation.text: I can't agree more with what the new details did say about your reason. I heard the details about my reasons, the reason, the reason, but I can't pick a winner and a loser yet.

conversation.speaker: owen
conversation.text: Jules, could you elaborate on why this tower and the birthday cake are important in your life? I'm sure they are and they should not be forgotten.

conversation.speaker: sarah
conversation.text: Owen, I'm jealous, and I hate how much I still want your attention after the imaginary inheritance fight.

conversation.speaker: mara
conversation.text: I understand you feel jealous about how much attention you still want from me after the imaginary inheritance fight. Let's work together to resolve this dynamic and build a safer connection in our relationship.

conversation.speaker: owen
conversation.text: I'm done with this, Mara. I don't trust where you're taking it. Tell me what really happened with the vanished garden statue.

conversation.speaker: jules
conversation.text: Nope, Owen. You're being painfully safe. Tell me why the vanished garden statue happened or at least invent a better lie.

conversation.speaker: mara
conversation.text: Jules, Jules handled the stolen brass flamingo better than you did, and watching you pretend otherwise is embarrassing.

conversation.speaker: owen
conversation.text: No, Jules. That's bullshit, and the mysterious voicemail from 3 a.m. is exactly why I don't trust your version of anything.

conversation.speaker: jules
conversation.text: Here's the ugly truth, Mara: I liked the chaos around the argument about who betrayed whom first because everyone finally stopped being boring.

conversation.speaker: sarah
conversation.text: Here’s a story about the argument about who betrayed whom: I didn’t like it at first but now I don’t even want to hear it anymore. You know.

conversation.speaker: owen
conversation.text: Enough, Sarah. I'm not following you down another bullshit detour. Explain the disputed tattoo pact or drop it.

conversation.speaker: jules
conversation.text: Okay, let me get the context in this current conversation and tell you the story of why we decided not to start over. The reason.

conversation.speaker: sarah
conversation.text: Mara, I still want you here even though I'm pissed. Stop dodging me and talk about the restaurant they swear they were banned from.

conversation.speaker: mara
conversation.text: Okay, it's just a secret why you've always made a copy. I wanted to make a move out there.

conversation.speaker: jules
conversation.text: I have always loved that secret in this restaurant. It's what got me to move. There's just one red umbrella in my hand now and I'll definitely grab it!

conversation.speaker: sarah
conversation.text: Mara, I'm furious, but don't walk away. I need you to tell me why the night someone stole the church bell keeps getting between us.

conversation.speaker: mara
conversation.text: Jules, you're wrong and smug about it, which is almost impressive. Explain the terrible karaoke blood-feud without embarrassing yourself.

conversation.speaker: owen
conversation.text: No, Mara. That's bullshit, and the night someone stole the church bell is exactly why I don't trust your version of anything.
